randomize-result-discarded.markdownDescription:
The result of randomize() is discarded.

randomize() returns 0 when the constraints cannot be met and then leaves the variables unchanged; a discarded result lets the test run on with stale values.

suppression-unmatched.markdownDescription:
`dvicode-lint: enable=` without a `disable=` before it.

An enable that ends no suppression usually means the disable was removed or misspelled.

trailing-whitespace.markdownDescription:
A line ends in spaces or tabs.

Trailing whitespace is invisible noise in diffs and reviews.

uvm-registration-mismatch.markdownDescription:
A UVM registration macro does not fit its class.

The factory creates what the macro registers: another class's name, the object macro on a component, or a non-parameterized macro on a parameterized class registers the wrong thing or fails to compile only where the factory is used.

waiver-unattached.markdownDescription:
A waiver is followed by no statement or declaration it could cover.

A waiver covers the statement or declaration right after it; one before `end`, `else` or the end of the file covers nothing.

waiver-unknown-id.markdownDescription:
A waiver or suppression names a rule that does not exist.

A misspelled rule ID waives nothing, so the finding it was meant for stays (or a later one goes unnoticed).

waiver-without-reason.markdownDescription:
A waiver or suppression gives no reason.

The style guide (§0) requires every waiver to say why the rule does not apply; a reason is what reviewers and later readers check.

rulesets.description: recommended: provable correctness rules; recommended-preview: correctness rules still under review; hexk: the HEXK SV/UVM Style Guide (includes the others)

extends.description: parent (default): start from the configuration above; none: from the defaults
